_README: Adjudications for check-league-fixture-reset-coverage.mjs.
Each entry says: this table IS league-scoped, and the per-league test fixture
(db/fixtures/league.mjs) deliberately does not clear it. A reason is required.
This is NOT a name filter -- the gate refuses to let it decay into one:
- An entry that suppresses nothing is itself a finding. Add the table to the
fixture, or drop it from the schema, and this entry must go with it.
- `writer_roots` records the roots holding an INSERT site for the table at
the time the reason was written, and the gate re-derives it every run. It
is a recorded FACT, not a reachability claim: if a table adjudicated as
unwritten-by-the-suite gains an insert site in api/ or libs-server/, the
entry is reported so the reason gets re-read rather than inherited.
The evidence behind every `no_suite_writer` reason below is one measurement,
made 2026-08-14: db/fixtures/league.mjs was instrumented to probe every
league-scoped table for rows AT FIXTURE ENTRY, and the full suite (3686
passing) was run. These 16 tables held rows at no fixture entry, so no spec
puts per-league rows in them and there is nothing to leak. Eight tables that
DID hold rows there were added to the fixture in the same change rather than
adjudicated. Re-run that probe rather than trusting these entries if you are
about to rely on one.
Note the measurement bounds the reason, not the gate: a table no spec writes
cannot leak today, and the day a spec starts writing one, the writer_roots
ratchet above is what surfaces it.
